text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 30, 2019 Posted by admin on January 30th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +220 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +51.74 (+0.21%) at 24,579.96.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.37%.
There were 12 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Pfizer (PFE) +3.14%, United Technologies (UTX) +2.40% and 3M (MMM) +1.94%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Verizon (VZ) -3.25%, Microsoft (MSFT) -2.04% and Apple (AAPL) -1.04%.
Microsoft (MSFT) reports earnings after the close today.
The FOMC Meeting ends today with announcement at 11:00 am PST.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.256 per gallon.
